LanguageData.PP_QuestNeedsColony: Start or load a colony to adjust quests for the current storyteller.
LanguageData.PP_QuestNoRandomQuests: {0} does not use random storyteller quests.
LanguageData.PP_CurrentStorytellerTip: These quest settings apply only to the storyteller running this colony. Other storytellers keep their vanilla timing.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchSectionTip: Change how expensive research is for each tech era.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchResetTip: Restore research multipliers, add-ons, rounding, and gravdata exclusion to defaults.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchEraTip: Settings on this block apply to {0} research projects.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchTotalsTip: Live count of techs in this era and their total cost with your current multiplier, add-on, and rounding.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchAllTotalsTip: Live count of every research project and their combined cost with your current multipliers, add-ons, rounding, and gravdata exclusion.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchMultiplierTip: Multiplies the original cost of every research in this era. 100% is vanilla.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchAddonTip: Adds this many research points to every tech in this era after the multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.PP_ResearchRoundingTip: Rounds each tech's final cost to the nearest multiple of this number. 1 means no extra rounding.
LanguageData.PP_ExcludeGravdataTip: Leave Vanilla Gravship Expanded gravdata techs at their original cost.
LanguageData.PP_PowerSectionTip: Change how much power generators produce.
LanguageData.PP_PowerResetTip: Restore power output and rounding to defaults.
LanguageData.PP_PowerOutputMultiplierTip: Multiplies generator power output. 100% is vanilla. Buildings that consume power are unchanged.
LanguageData.PP_PowerOutputRoundingTip: Rounds generator output to the nearest multiple of this number. 1 means no extra rounding.
LanguageData.PP_QuestSectionTip: Change how often this colony's storyteller offers random quests.
LanguageData.PP_QuestResetTip: Restore this storyteller's random quest timing to vanilla.
LanguageData.PP_QuestCycleDaysTip: How many days each quest cycle lasts. Longer cycles mean random quests arrive less often.
LanguageData.PP_QuestMinDaysBetweenTip: Minimum days the storyteller waits between random quests in the same cycle.
LanguageData.PP_QuestCountTip: How many random quests the storyteller tries to offer in each cycle.
